name: Matthieu Letho Duclos
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A French middleweight from Venum Training Camp Paris (11-3, age 31), long at 191 cm with a 196 cm reach. He knocked out Luis Felipe Dias in R1 in his UFC debut in September; he was stopped by Marco Tulio on the 2024 Contender Series.

how_they_fight.Striking: Nine knockouts in our data (five in R1, four in R2).
how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped three times, all in R1-R2.

keys_to_beat: Close the distance and land first

sources.author: Mike Heck
